Exam Date & Time: 20-Apr-2023 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. (MAKEUP) EXAMINATIONS - APRIL 2023  
  SUBJECT: CIE-1072 / CIE -1052 - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  (REGULARS - LATE ADMISSION BATCH)  
  Environmental Studies [CIE-1072]  
Marks: 50                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Why is GDP used as a metric for overall improvement in human life?  
  (5)  
  
1B)             Write a note on in situ & ex situ methods of conservation.  
  (5)  
  
2A)             Write an article on major primary pollutants.  
  (5)  
  
2B)             What are the different types of plastics as per BIS classification?  
  (5)  
  
3A)             Discuss in brief the evolution of India's Environmental policy with a flowchart.  
  (5)  
  
3B)             List the functions of central pollution control board.  
  (5)  
  
4A)             Discuss on the laws governing usage and conservation of water resources in India.  
  (5)  
  
4B)             With a case study describe how unscientific and unsustainable urbanization has led to  
  modern day floods.                                                                      (5)  
  
5A)             Extreme positive departures from the normal maximum temperature result in a heat  
  wave during the summer season. Explain.                                                 (5)  
  
5B)             Explain the following:  
  (i) Biological hazard.                                                                  (5)  
  (ii) Early warning system.  
  
  
-----End-----
